summary: Omar Merlos, 25, of Hotchkiss, reported missing Mar 11 after failing to show for work; his abandoned vehicle was found Mar 12 just inside Gunnison County on Bear Creek Road near Somerset, and responders located his body near Bear Creek during a search of the area; investigators treating the death as suicide.
notes: Run 1008: KVNF Regional Newscast Apr 3, 2023 — reported missing Mar 11, vehicle found Mar 12, body located during search near the vehicle; exact body-recovery day not separately dated in source, so date is the Mar 12 vehicle-discovery/search day (approximate); investigators treating death as suicide; Delta County Sheriff's Office assisted. In scope per the id-2767 missing-person-found-deceased precedent.
